title.zh: Perplexity开源新Embedding模型：整篇一起读，切块也能带着上下文
title.en: Perplexity开源新Embedding模型：整篇一起读，切块也能带着上下文

current_state.zh: Perplexity open-sourced pplx-embed-v2-context-9b-preview under an MIT license on Hugging Face, an embedding model that encodes long documents as a whole so each chunk's vector carries global context and evidence-supporting passages, reportedly beating Voyage Context 4 by 14.4 points on Answer@10 and 5 points on Evidence Recall@10 in turbopuffer's blind context-bench.
